About Us

Welcome to Fine Circuits and Components Private Limited

Your Perfect PCB Partner for The Sustainable Future

Fine Circuits and Components Private Limited, established in 2001, is a 100% Export Oriented Unit (EOU) specializing in high-quality Printed Circuit Board (PCB) manufacturing. With a state-of-the-art 60,000 sq. ft. facility near Baroda, Gujarat, Fine Circuits and Components Private Limited has a production capacity of 5,000 sq. meters per month for Single, Double, and Multi-Layer PCBs. Its North American operations are represented by Fine Circuits and Components Private Limited Electronics in Elk Grove Village, Illinois. Committed to innovation, quality, and timely delivery, Fine Circuits and Components Private Limited’s skilled workforce continuously upgrades its expertise to keep pace with evolving technologies, ensuring precision, efficiency, and customer satisfaction.

Vision

To become a leading global player in the Printed Circuit Board Industry by leveraging innovation, quality manufacturing, and on-time delivery, while expanding our market share in the USA and strengthening our presence in the domestic market. We aim to drive sustainable growth by embracing cutting-edge technology and delivering superior products that exceed customer expectations.

Mission

To establish Fine Circuits and Components Private Limited as a trusted partner in the Printed Circuit Board manufacturing industry, by providing reliable, consistent and cost-effective solutions. We are committed to delivering on-time, high-quality products that meet the evolving needs of our customers, while fostering long-term relationships based on trust and excellence.

Values
  1. To build lasting customer-vendor relationships through proven reliability, exceptional quality and unwavering commitment to customer satisfaction.
  2. To uphold and integrate human values as the corner stone for the growth and well-being of the Company, our employees, customers and vendors.
  3. To actively contribute to the environmental sustainability by operating an eco-friendly manufacturing facility, blending cutting-edge technology with required human efforts to preserve nature for future generations.
